basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Research Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Kharagpur is hiring one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Research for the project "Automation and Setting Up of a Reference Lab for Validating Cryptographic Algorithms/Modules as per ISO/IEC Standards" (Project Code – R/RVI), sponsored by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (Government of India). The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 37,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience, for 13 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice describes the assignment as a temporary one. Its qualification and experience requirements for the single JRF (Research) post are below. Four years Bachelor's Degree in Biology related Sciences / Master's Degree in Biological sciences / B. Pharm or Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology / M. Pharm or Masters' degree in Engineering or Technology or in medicine from a recognized University or equivalent. The candidate must also have been selected through a process described in any one of the following: Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. The selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. The notice states that the applicant MUST have at least 8.5 CGPA or 80% marks throughout all examinations starting from Class 10. Knowledge in Cryptography and Hardware Security Proficiency in Programming (preferably in C/C++) Knowledge of Hardware Design Language (like Verilog or SystemVerilog) The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF (Research) posts has IIT Kharagpur announced?
faq.answer: IIT Kharagpur has announced 1 post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Research in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: The notice prints a four years Bachelor's Degree in Biology related Sciences, a Master's Degree in Biological sciences, B. Pharm, a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology, M. Pharm, or a Master's degree in Engineering or Technology or in medicine, from a recognized University or equivalent. Selection through CSIR-UGC NET or GATE, or a qualifying national level examination, is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the IIT Kharagpur JRF post?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 37,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project. The tenure is 13 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Which project is the post for?
faq.answer: The post is for the project "Automation and Setting Up of a Reference Lab for Validating Cryptographic Algorithms/Modules as per ISO/IEC Standards" (Project Code – R/RVI), sponsored by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. The PI/Co-PI is Prof./Dr. Aritra Hazra.

faq.question: Q10. Is a minimum percentage required?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states that the applicant MUST have at least 8.5 CGPA or 80% marks throughout all examinations starting from Class 10.
